summary: Large introduction band for a portal page: projected title, subtitle, content and actions, optional decorative background image under a readable overlay.

inputs.name: variant
inputs.description: Surface without an image: muted page surface or brand primary colour.

inputs.name: imageSrc
inputs.description: Decorative background image served by the app; adds a dark overlay and light text.

slots.description: The heading element (usually the page h1).
A short paragraph under the title.
Free content between the subtitle and the actions.

a11y: The image is decorative (alt empty) and the overlay is aria-hidden; the projected heading carries the meaning. Coloured variants re-point the text tokens so contrast holds.
